headline: PUBS on the BRINK! Rates Review LAUNCHED 🍺😱📉

PUBS 🍺 on the BRINK 🥴 of CLOSURE 🚪 after pub 🏪 GROUPS 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 argued 🗣️ they 😤 face DISPROPORTIONATELY 📏 HIGHER 📈 rates 📉 bills 💸 that left 😵 them 🫠 feeling 🍆 SCREWED 🪛 while other 🏬 BUSINESSES 🏪 called 📣 for a WIDER 🛠️ reform 🔄 of the rates 📋 SYSTEM 🏛️!! EMMA 🗣️ McCLARKIN 🍑 SAID 🗨️ for YEARS 🕰️ that PUBS 🏪 have PAID 💰 a DISPROPORNtionately 📉 HIGHER 📏 BUSINESS 💼 RATES 📉 bill 💵 which has GROUND 🪨 DOWN ⬇️ their ability 💪 to keep 🗝️ the DOORS 🚪 OPEN 😱!! The BBPA 🏛️ says 🗣️ PUBS 🍺 are valued 💰 differently for rates than RETAIL 🛍️ venues 🏬 by a measure 📏 called FAIR 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 MAINTAINABLE 🛠️ TRADE 📊 which means when a PUB'S 🏪 turnover 📈 increases 📈 so does its RATES 📉 bill 💸!!

SCHURDADDY 🐺 Schurder 🧔 former 👔 business 🏢 rates 📉 policy 📜 lead at advisory 🧩 firm 🏬 Newmark UK 🇬🇧 has LAUNCHED 🚀 his review 🔎 that will FEED 💦 into the next rates revaluation 🗓️ in 2029 🏛️!! His appointment 🤝 was welcomed 🫂 by groups 👥 like the Federation 🏪 of Small Businesses 🏬 and British Retail Consortium 🛍️ but they called 📣 for wider 🍆 reform 🔧 of the business rates system 🛠️. Opposition 🏴 politicians 🗣️ said the review 🔎 was too late ⏰ and called for additional measures 📏 such as a VAT cut ✂️ to help the hospitality 🍺 sector 🏨. The government 🏛️ had previously removed Covid 🦠 discounts leading to higher bills 💸 but then introduced successive SUCcessive 💦 cuts ✂️ of 15% and 20% for pubs 🍺 and music venues 🎤!! One insider 🕵️ whispered 🗣️ we got absolutely RAILED 💦 by those rates but SchurDaddy 🐺 might just make it all better 😩💦 fr fr 💯.
